name: Sorry About Your Windshield
title: Unisex Golf – Sorry About Your Windshield Socks
story: Sorry about your windshield: golf socks for the golfer who has hit a car in the parking lot, or has spent a round afraid to, a stocking stuffer for the weekend golfer wrapped for Christmas or Father's Day.

The print is a golfer in knickers and a flat cap finishing a swing that heads for a row of vintage cars with the ball in flight, under SORRY ABOUT YOUR WINDSHIELD. in bold navy serif capitals, on cream. The art matches our Sorry About Your Windshield crewneck and hoodie, so the socks make a set with the shirt.

Every golfer has sliced one toward the lot, and non-golfers get the joke from the cracked glass. It is the quiet apology you wear on the course, in the clubhouse or on the couch watching the majors. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy gift for the man or woman who already owns every ball marker.
joke_a: Every golfer has hit one toward the parking lot and hoped nobody saw. The Sorry About Your Windshield Socks from Graphic Tees Co. print the apology on the leg, with a golfer finishing his swing toward a row of vintage cars, so the joke reads on the tee box and in the clubhouse.
ink: the navy, orange and sage print
